executor.task_timeout_note: no DSH execution deadline; the session waits for native turn/end+idle. --timeout (default 1250s) bounds only the caller-side wait and never cancels, kills or resubmits the job
executor.delivery: send --wait; on wait timeout reconnect with wait on the same output directory
executor.legacy_runner: workflow/dsh_runner.py one-shot run_task(timeout=1200) kills the SDK at its deadline; unsuitable for production long tasks, diagnostics/smoke only
executor.steering: Native next-step only; bind active session/job/turn and approved supplemental Spec; reject legacy/inactive targets without queueing

merge_policy: Codex review and required checks on current head; official behavior changes additionally require owner intranet PASS naming that exact head SHA
notes: Worktree/prompt restrictions are not an OS sandbox. No automatic raw log upload. No model fallback.
context_management: DSH native only; no manual history, compression or reconstruction
dispatch_policy: Codex handles difficult or ambiguous issues directly; delegate bounded and independently verifiable tasks; escalate after two failed attempts
